# `needless-switch-else-capture`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports an unused capture on a switch `else` prong.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An unused name suggests that the fallback value influences behavior when it does
not.

## When it fires

It applies when the capture can be removed without affecting the prong body.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn run(value: u32) u32 {
    return switch (value) {
        0 => 1,
        else => |payload| 2,
    };
}
```
